hooks.after:bump: bun run build && bunx git-cliff --config cliff.toml --output CHANGELOG.md --tag v${version}

github.releaseNotes: bunx git-cliff --config cliff.toml --output - --unreleased --tag v${version} --strip header && echo && echo 'Full changelog: https://github.com/gander-labs/new-bun-app/blob/v${version}/CHANGELOG.md'
